field_descriptions.drains_to: The vasculature that the vein drains into.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.region_drained: The anatomical or organ system drained by this vessel; generally refers to a specific part of an organ.
field_descriptions.tributary: The anatomical or organ system that the vein flows into; a larger structure that the vein connects to.
